answer: Each new agent identity must mint a "pulse proof": solving a memory-hard puzzle costing 50 GPU-seconds, and fee per identity is quadratic—2 tokens × n² where n is the number of identities already created by the same funding wallet. The ridge between honest agents (1 pulse) and Sybil farmers (n² cost curve) grows so fast that 100 fakes cost ~20,000 tokens, while a prism audit samples behavioral fingerprints; mismatches burn the whole wallet's fee balance.
